surface.title: Agent-led install and project adoption
surface.location: Public install entry → non-interactive setup → yoke-global → /yoke onboard
surface.note: Existing and mature projects need intake and preservation, not a forced blank-slate scaffold. Full project onboarding remains a project operation.
surface.current: Observed 2026-10-12: setup --help has noninteractive support but no --agent or --answer flags.
surface.desired: Same setup engine with structured resumable answers; relevant GitHub explanation; readiness then project-bound minimal onboard.
